correctness.rationale: Independent exact enumeration of all n across shells h=1..4 reproduces all sixteen interval counts and four totals. Analytically, exact palindrome counts at boundaries, one/two-event block decompositions, the signed base-four swapping identity and T_h=(B^2-2^h)/7 prove the formulas for every h>=1. Three density subsequences follow by a geometric sum. Finite checks alone are explicitly insufficient.

originality.rationale: The full relevant primary papers (2019 exact individual counts, 2021 races, 2023 sharpened pointwise comparison) were read and compared for implied sign-frequency and density conclusions. Their pointwise formulas permit evaluating individual counts but do not give exact distribution counts. Extensive specified indexed-record queries and public searching found no covering census; unindexed equivalent results remain a residual risk.
residual_risks: A comparable sign-frequency theorem in poorly indexed or inaccessible publications cannot be ruled out by search.
The results are not a classification for arbitrary unequal bases.

value.rationale: The initiating literature explicitly studies a race between palindrome-counting functions, but frequency of wins, losses and ties is structurally different from merely identifying sign changes. Exact infinite-shell census and proven nonexistence of the winner set natural density are meaningful invariants of this motivated binary–quaternary comparison, not arbitrary small-case computations.
